purpose: Local contract for Claude/Arena handoff intake. This is a paper-only integration boundary, not a live trading permission.

notes: No remote Arena deployment is implied by this local repository contract.
Any Arena runner must remain paper-only and pass the shared risk gate.
No strategy can set can_trade=true from this contract.

basis_input_table.notes: The local repo can specify and validate this schema, but it does not prove the remote Arena collector exists.

edge_tasks.claim: Basis-shock reversion may become testable with larger multi-symbol Binance Vision data.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Multi-symbol data fixed train sample size and produced train-qualified candidates, but the selected candidate failed validation on min_trades and cost_stress_positive; OOS remained unopened.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Reject this specific mechanism for promotion; research only genuinely new precommitted basis mechanisms without reusing opened validation for retuning.

edge_tasks.claim: A genuinely new cross-sectional basis dispersion mechanism may work better than absolute basis shock/carry rules.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: The preregistered grid tested 324 configs; zero configs passed train gate. Best train config had negative mean net bps and poor positive rate, so validation and OOS stayed unopened.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Reject this specific dispersion mechanism. Do not retune it on closed validation; only continue with materially different preregistered basis mechanisms.

edge_tasks.claim: Long/short-ratio crowd fade may be useful if it passes strict validation.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Nested holdout found zero train-qualified variants; shadow observer is not trade permission.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Only retest after materially improved or extended positioning data; keep observer/paper boundaries.

edge_tasks.claim: A multi-symbol carry basket may have enough basis/funding events where BTC-only did not.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Multi-symbol train produced qualified candidates, but the selected carry rule had zero validation trades; OOS remained unopened.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Do not port selected carry configs to Arena. If continuing, preregister a different carry mechanism or less brittle regime definition before testing.

edge_tasks.claim: Existing 4H observer should run to a resolved validation conclusion.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Forward outcomes are not sufficient for promotion.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Continue observer, accumulate independent resolved outcomes, and let promotion gate decide.

edge_tasks.claim: Liquidation-cascade rebound should be validated on real liquidation feed rather than order-book proxy.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Binance Vision archive candidates returned no event files in discovery. Forward websocket collector is monitored by a data-quality guard and currently has zero event-level rows; strategy consumer remains disabled until real rows accumulate.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Keep the forceOrder collector running, monitor LIQUIDATION_FORCE_ORDER_DATA_QUALITY, then preregister a liquidation-feed hypothesis only after enough schema-valid real events exist.

edge_tasks.claim: Spread/depth imbalance on L2 or tick data may contain short-horizon edge after costs.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Microstructure snapshot is not sealed yet; no OOS proof exists.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Wait for sealed 168h snapshot, then let the post-seal guard run the locked preregistered queue.

edge_tasks.claim: Arena edge_verdict should be upgraded from naive cum_realized checks to Codex-strict gates.
edge_tasks.blocking_reason: Remote Arena code is outside this local runtime and is not modified by this contract.
edge_tasks.next_safe_action: Export this contract as a paper-only spec; remote implementation must preserve no-real-order boundary.

drift_notes.note: The Arena onboarding text says basis_funding_carry is nested-holdout validated, but current local Codex artifacts reject both BTC-only and multi-symbol basis/funding carry/shock runs. Treat as drift; local artifacts win.
Arena tables, timers, dashboards and host details are external. They are not considered runnable local components without remote proof.
All imported Arena concepts remain paper-only. This repository must not create real orders from these handoffs.
